The [[Ruby Djinn Polymock Piece]] is one of the 18 pieces that a player can pick while playing [[Polymock]].

When using this piece, you take the [[Ruby Djinn Form]].

[[Category:Polymock pieces]]

==Acquisition==
This piece drops as a reward from [[Murakai's Chest]], [[Hidesplitter's Chest]] and [[Chest of Kathandrax]].
